desc:
🗿 NEW UPDATE: TITAN RAID + 3 NEW TENTACLES 🗿

Grow 4 giant robot arms. They carry you down the street, climb you up skyscrapers, catch you when you fall and smash anything in Tokyo.

[NEW]
🗿 TITAN RAID: team up with 6 players against a giant boss. Beat it and you might take its arms
🌳 NATURE: living tree arms covered in leaves and flowers
⛈️ THUNDERSTORM: storm cloud arms. Strike lightning wherever you point
🧸 PLUSHY: soft pink paws and teddy bear hugs
🤖 New robots: Leech, Clamp and Bulldozer
⭐ Levels now go all the way to 100
⚔️ DUEL and BATTLE other players

[How To Play]
🕹️ WASD to move, Shift to rush
🧗 Walk into a wall to climb it
👊 Click to strike, E to grab and throw, Q to slam
🛡️ F to block, Ctrl to dodge
✨ 1, 2, 3 for your abilities

🐙 12 tentacles to collect, paint every arm your way
🎁 Join the group for free colours
🎮 Play on phone, tablet, PC and console
